observations: Three photos show a single car headlight assembly, not a set of two.
The headlight has a chrome bezel, clear lens, and an amber turn signal section.
The housing is black plastic with visible mounting points and clips.
The lens shows some scratches and dirt, especially on the left side in photo 0.
No visible branding or model markings on the headlight itself in any photo.
The headlight is resting on a dirt ground next to a white vehicle or structure.
The seller claims it is for a 'Volkswagen Passat CC 2010', but no evidence in photos confirms this.

claims.claim: Set of full light Volkswagen Passat CC 2010
claims.evidence: Only one headlight is shown in all three photos; no branding or model identifiers are visible to confirm it is for a Passat CC 2010.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken bulb holder, or missing internal components).
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the internal components, including the bulb sockets and reflector, and a test video showing the lights turning on.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit a Volkswagen Passat CC 2010, or may be from a different model/year.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or VIN tag on the back of the headlight, or a comparison shot with a known Passat CC 2010 headlight.

proof_requests: A photo of the back of the headlight showing any part numbers or model identifiers.
A photo of the headlight installed on a Passat CC 2010, or a side-by-side comparison with a known genuine unit.
A video showing the headlight lights turning on and off.
response.reason: Only one headlight is shown, contradicting the 'set' claim. No visible branding or model identifiers confirm it is for a Passat CC 2010. Without proof of compatibility and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately.
